what_happened: Found the real OOM lever: LEAN_NUM_THREADS. Lake has no -j/--jobs flag because Lean exposes no API for a host program to cap its own Task thread pool; the pool size (defaulting to the runner's vCPU count) IS capped via the LEAN_NUM_THREADS env var, confirmed by Lake/Lean maintainers on Zulip, documented in leanprover/lean-action's own README for the structurally identical leanchecker-OOM case, and used in production by opencompl/veir's docs.yml specifically to stop doc-gen4 OOMing ('Lake runs one job per core ... run out of memory'). This is reachable purely as a step-level env var in docs.yml -- no action fork needed.
